sys_script_fix.description: v0.6 (O03): fills every tracked object's drift fields from the stored observations. Change-only; runs on install/upgrade.
sys_script_fix.name: Driftwood - Recompute all drift
sys_script_fix.script: /* Driftwood - Recompute all drift (v0.6, O03) * Fills or refreshes the drift fields of every tracked object from the * stored observations (same rules as Drift Report > All instances). * Change-only and safe to re-run. Runs automatically when Driftwood is * installed or upgraded from the application repository, after the * backfill (fix scripts run in name order: "Backfill" before "Recompute"). * * Dry run first: Scripts - Background, script scope Driftwood: * gs.info(new ConfigNowDrift().recompute({ dryRun: true }).text); */ gs.info(new ConfigNowDrift().recompute().text);
